channel.title: Mix That Drink - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Mix That Drink (mixthatdrink.com)

item.title: Skittles Vodka Recipe
item.description: Turn a pound of Skittles and a bottle of vodka into five neon flasks, including prep ratios, cleanup tips, and rum variation notes.

item.title: 23 Christmas Cocktails to Enjoy This Holiday
item.description: Try these Christmas cocktails to elevate your holiday celebrations, from Mistletoe Martinis to Mulled Wine, with recipes for every taste and occasion!

item.title: Grape Russian Tea
item.description: A sweet, fizzy grape vodka cocktail with bright lemon and cola that tastes like Grape Coke with a kick.

item.title: Christmas Cookie cocktail recipe
item.description: Savor the festive Christmas Cookie cocktail, featuring peppermint schnapps, Kahlua, and Irish cream. A year-round treat that pairs well with chocolate delights!

item.title: Eggnog Martini: a Vodka Christmas Cocktail
item.description: The Eggnog Martini recipe takes ordinary eggnog and mixes it with vanilla vodka, amaretto and more. It's a lighter version of eggnog with a wonderful flavor.

item.title: Very Cherry Christmas Drink Recipe
item.description: Try the Very Cherry Christmas drink, a festive cocktail blending cherry vodka, chocolate, and Irish cream for a sweet, holiday delight. Perfect for parties!

item.title: Mistletoe Martini Cranberry Christmas Cocktail
item.description: Make the refreshing Mistletoe Martini, a holiday cocktail blending cranberry and elderflower flavors. Perfect for parties, with easy prep and garnishes.

item.title: Nutcracker Cocktail
item.description: The Nutcracker cocktail is a sweet blend of coffee, almond, and citrus with a creamy finish, perfect for holiday celebrations.

item.title: Candy Cane Vodka Infusion Tutorial
item.description: Create a festive Candy Cane Vodka with just vodka and candy canes. Quick to make in a few hours, perfect for holiday cocktails or gifts. Enjoy minty sweetness!

item.title: Santa Shot Cocktail Recipe
item.description: Savor the festive Santa Shot with mint and berry flavors, perfect for holiday parties. Easy to make, layer grenadine, creme de menthe, and peppermint schnapps.
